description: This PHP class 'Salary' extends ListableDisplayField and is part of the OrangeHRM system. It provides metadata and configuration for displaying salary information in reports, including methods to get the associated DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: Represents a display field configuration for salary information, extending ListableDisplayField, with methods to specify DTO class, entity aliases, and report fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field, which is 'Dto\Salary'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in query building, in this case ['salary'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields associated with this display field, here ['employee.empNumber'].
